- BUSINESS CARD

For example: If you get visitors, your guest wants to go online and asks you for your access data, show him this code. Your guest's smartphone will then automatically connect to your router.

- INTERNET LINK
Create an "Internet Link" code with the address of your homepage.

For example: When you are asked for your homepage, show this code. If a smartphone scans this code, the browser will automatically start and show your homepage.
